policy: Label-blind engineering screening; evidence scores are not probabilities. Freeze before reference evaluation; no reference IDs used in features, tuning, or eligibility.

managed_charging.availability: From first detected arrival to next 06:00; assumed plugged in until deadline. Never move before arrival or across an incomplete window.
managed_charging.charger_limit: 50% of maximum estimated session component power; other load including the remaining 50% stays fixed.
managed_charging.interpretation: Scenario on estimated EV-like components, not measured charging or customer commitments. No utility control cost supplied.
